metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to self fix a short leg at home. These exercises are EASY and EFFECTIVE and don't require any special equipment!

If you're dealing with a short leg, or a high hip, caused by an uneven pelvis -- this video will help self mobilize the joints and soft tissue in and around the pelvic region.

We're going to go over lower back and pelvic stretches and exercises that focus on getting everything moving. This may help RESET the pelvis, and bring the alignment of the hips back into balance.

Also, we'll focus on strengthening the muscles, ligaments, and tendons around the pelvis. This may help build a STRONGER foundation in your lower back, pelvis, and hips and ward off future issues of a high hip and a short leg. 

As a bonus, it may help you maintain your ALIGNMENT longer in-between chiropractic adjustments.

WATCH NOW and get rid of a short leg at home!
